items.summary: First Japan fanclub-exclusive photobook featuring Korean model 표은지 (Pyo Eunji), originally released in 2022 to mark the start of her Japanese activities. The reviewed listing is a restock offer for the 168-page book.
items.details: Artist-store page explicitly says the first fanclub photobook was released in 2022; only year precision is known. A4, 168 pages; descriptive original price JPY 4,800 tax included. Restock offer displays MYR 141.00 and disabled SOLD OUT button plus a members-only notice. This is distinct from the 150-page annual PHOTO BOOK 2022 and from KADOKAWA Rondo. The only current product image has a Sold Out overlay; it is retained on the listing as a promotional product image, not asserted to be a clean book cover. Image URL is a remote reference, with no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.
items.evidence: Live artist-store page checked around 23:02 SGT on 2026-10-23. It displays tax-included MYR 141.00 and a disabled SOLD OUT button, also with a members-only notice.
